### 1. Cycle Rebalancing Framework

#### A. Economic Growth Phase (Expansion / Inflationary Upswing)
* **Macro Environment**: Rising CPI, increasing market interest rates, strong corporate earnings growth.
* **Adjustment Pathways**:
  * Maintain core fixed-income and annuity baselines.
  * Direct discretionary SIP contributions slightly toward participating annuities (分红型) or low-risk dividend funds, capturing corporate profit growth while keeping the guaranteed base intact.
  * Rely on real-expense reimbursement medical policies (Million/Mid-End Medical and [MASKED]) rather than fixed-cash policies to absorb elevated medical cost inflation.

#### B. Economic Recession Phase (Rate Cuts / Deflationary Pressure)
* **Macro Environment**: Central bank benchmark rate cuts, declining bond yields, market volatility.
* **Adjustment Pathways**:
  * Swiftly lock in remaining long-duration guaranteed yield instruments (such as 2.5% Increasing Whole Life and long-term commercial pension annuities) before insurers lower product rate caps [国家金融监督管理总局](https://www.nfra.gov.cn/cn/view/pages/ItemDetail.html?docId=1175200&itemId=4110&generaltype=1).
  * Shift liquid portfolio reserves into long-duration sovereign [MASKED] bonds to capture capital gains as interest rates fall [[MASKED]).

#### C. Economic Stability Phase (Neutral Cycle)
* **Macro Environment**: Stable CPI, range-bound interest rates, steady wage growth.
* **Adjustment Pathways**:
  * Rebalance back to baseline lifecycle weightings annually.
  * Maintain regular monthly SIP contributions and maximize the annual 12,000 RMB tax-deferred [MASKED] quota [科技日报](https://www.stdaily.com/web/gdxw/2025-01/30/content_292289.html).
